title: Navimower 0.5.0-beta8

## Scheduler V2

This beta replaces the accumulated managed-Schedule ownership/provenance wrapper
chain with one explicit **time-window + queue pointer** state machine.

The matching frontend prerelease is **Navimower Map Card 0.4.0-beta7**.

### No task ownership

Schedule no longer tries to prove that a vendor-retained task "belongs" to Home
Assistant. The persisted execution model is intentionally small:

- round index and round queue snapshot;
- current positional queue slot and zone;
- completion baseline and dispatch time;
- whether that slot is unfinished;
- pending command / interruption reason.

Old ownership fields such as owned zone, ownership source and
queue-slot-ownership verification no longer decide dispatch.

### Time window is the policy boundary

While the Time window is open:

- a completed slot advances directly to the next configured slot;
- the end of the queue immediately starts the next round from slot 0;
- no Docked boundary is required between zones or rounds;
- a stale Mowing snapshot from the just-completed zone is explicitly ignored
  during that direct handoff.

While the Time window is closed:

- Schedule never starts/continues mowing;
- any actual Mowing/Paused attempt is sent Home/Dock;
- this catches sunrise auto-resume and post-charge retained-task auto-resume.

### Dock probe when the window closes

If a slot is unfinished when the window closes, Schedule sends one **Dock probe**
even if the mower is already charging/docked. This intentionally tests whether
the vendor clears/suppresses the retained task in that state.

Diagnostics retain the probe timestamp/result. The V2 policy does not depend on
the probe succeeding: if the mower later starts mowing outside the window it is
sent Home again.

### Resume unfinished work next window

An unfinished slot survives the closed window.

When the next Time window opens:

1. V2 first sends vendor **Resume** (`c:behavior type=3`);
2. if Resume is not confirmed, it falls back to an exact one-zone
   `mow_zones(..., reset=false)` continue;
3. it never uses a fresh reset merely to recover retained work.

Low-battery charging follows the same model: below the configured charge limit
V2 waits; vendor self-resume is accepted; at/above the limit the retained slot
may be resumed while the Time window is open.

### Beta7 migration

The existing beta7 positional state is collapsed once into the V2 queue pointer.
Fresh vendor completion evidence after the stored round start is used to recover
slots that the old ownership guard failed to mark complete. Existing
`queue_slot_ownership_unverified` style suspensions do not survive the cutover.

## Current-cycle trail gap guard v2

Field diagnostics showed healthy H2 VendorTrailStore geometry and ready
artifacts, but **171 segment breaks** had been recorded by the old fixed 5 m
forward gap guard. Normal H-series compressed vendor geometry can legitimately
space consecutive retained points more than 5 m apart, producing the visible
white holes in otherwise completed mowing coverage.

Gap guard v2:

- uses an adaptive outlier threshold based on retained point spacing;
- never splits below 15 m and caps the threshold at 30 m;
- rescans records carrying the old gap-guard version;
- invalidates their cached current-cycle artifact so repaired geometry is
  rebuilt even when the vendor point digest itself is unchanged;
- retains genuinely large discontinuity protection for phantom-line cases.

Use the matching pair:

- Navimower 0.5.0-beta8
- Navimower Map Card 0.4.0-beta7
